title.en: Practice: a patient who stopped breathing on a morphine pump
title.de: Übung: ein Patient, der unter einer Morphinpumpe nicht mehr atmet

purpose: A toxic, hypoxic arrest (owner, 2026-10-24: toxins). The day after his operation, with a morphine pump, he has stopped breathing: for 6 min before the learner arrives (drive 0, `before`). He arrives unresponsive, apnoeic and desaturated, with a fast pulse; without breaths his heart runs down into PEA and asystole (as in the hypoxic practice). The lesson: breaths first (they prevent the arrest), naloxone alongside (it gives his own breathing back after a minute or two, ERC 2025 First aid), and, once he has arrested, standard ALS: naloxone does not restart a heart. The model has no opioid as such: the scene takes the breathing drive away, naloxone gives it back (gap 44: pupils, sedation and the opioid's own kinetics are not modelled).

place.en: A side room on the surgical ward
place.de: Ein Nebenzimmer auf der chirurgischen Station

label.de: Beatmungsbeutel mit Maske an der Wand

label.en: IV cannulas on the arrest trolley
Adrenaline and amiodarone on the arrest trolley
Suction, Magill forceps and airways on the arrest trolley
label.de: Absaugung, Magill-Zange und Atemwegshilfen am Notfallwagen

label.en: Alteplase (thrombolytic), brought with the arrest team
Warmed saline and a pressure bag, on the arrest trolley
label.de: Angewärmte Kochsalzlösung und Druckbeutel, am Notfallwagen

label.en: An ultrasound machine, brought with the arrest team
A pericardiocentesis set, brought with the arrest team

explain.en: His morphine pump had given him more than he could take: the opioid switched off his breathing, and his heart, starved of oxygen, ran down. Breaths with the bag bring oxygen back at once; naloxone gives him his own breathing back after a minute or two. Once the heart has stopped naloxone does not restart it: then it is compressions, breaths and the rest of ALS.
explain.de: Seine Morphinpumpe hatte ihm mehr gegeben, als er vertrug: das Opioid schaltete seine Atmung ab, und sein Herz erlahmte ohne Sauerstoff. Beutelbeatmung bringt sofort Sauerstoff zurück; Naloxon gibt ihm nach ein, zwei Minuten seine eigene Atmung zurück. Steht das Herz, startet Naloxon es nicht neu: dann Kompressionen, Beatmung und das übrige ALS.

text.en: He’s on a morphine pump since his operation. I can’t wake him, and he’s hardly breathing! What shall I do?
text.de: Er hat seit der Operation eine Morphinpumpe. Ich kann ihn nicht wecken, und er atmet kaum! Was soll ich tun?

text.en: I can’t feel a pulse any more!

explain.en: This run was set up so that he gasps after the collapse. Gasping is not breathing: an unresponsive patient who gasps is in cardiac arrest, and compressions should start without delay.
explain.de: Dieser Durchgang war so angelegt, dass er nach dem Kollaps Schnappatmung hat. Schnappatmung ist keine Atmung: Ein reaktionsloser Patient mit Schnappatmung hat einen Kreislaufstillstand, und die Kompressionen sollten ohne Verzögerung beginnen.
